description.value: Vivezza Vineyard is a family-owned boutique winery on Salt Spring Island, built on over two decades of research into disease-resistant grape varieties suited to BC's coastal climate. The estate produces two distinct lines: a Traditional Series from old-vine vinifera on Salt Spring and Vancouver Islands, and an innovative Modern Series featuring newly developed disease-resistant varieties grown on the estate itself. The cellar door offers direct wine sales and tastings, making it a genuine destination stop on one of BC's most scenic cycling islands.
